---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a new pathology detector, fix template, or feature
title: "[FEAT] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

**What kind of feature?**
- [ ] New pathology detector
- [ ] New libcst fix template
- [ ] New integration (framework)
- [ ] Dashboard / UX
- [ ] Benchmark fixture
- [ ] Other

**Problem**
What ML training failure mode does this address? Cite a paper or blog post if available.

**Proposed detection signal**
What metric or pattern reliably identifies the pathology?

**Proposed fix (if applicable)**
What source-level change resolves it? Provide a before/after diff if you can.

**Demo-friendliness**
Would this make a compelling 10-second demo clip?

**Additional context**
Links, references, prior art.
